journey.name: Duplicate and delete only a test layout
journey.description: Start on Controller after 03. Journey-Core-Layout exists and Journey-Core-Layout (Copy) does not. Only the copy created here may be deleted. Original is retained for persistence checks.

actions.action: Tap Search layouts and enter Journey-Core-Layout.
Verify that Journey-Core-Layout and Journey-Core-Layout (Copy) are listed.
Verify that Delete Layout Configuration? names Journey-Core-Layout (Copy).
Verify that Journey-Core-Layout (Copy) is still listed.
Tap Delete in the confirmation dialog.
Verify that the copy is absent and Journey-Core-Layout remains listed.
